bugs.error_message: PDF resume renders tiny inside the resume component instead of filling the .resume-frame-wrap div
bugs.root_cause: The <iframe class="resume-frame"> had no CSS rule, so it rendered at the browser default iframe size (300x150px) instead of filling its container
bugs.fix: Added a .resume-frame rule (flex: 1, width: 100%, border: 0, border-radius: 14px, background: #fff) and made .resume-frame-wrap a flex column so the iframe stretches to match the div at all breakpoints

bugs.error_message: The app doesn't navigate back from the /resume page using the nav bar
bugs.root_cause: Nav links (Home/Work/About + Portfolio brand) were pure in-page anchors using scrollIntoView on document.getElementById(id). Those sections only exist on the home page, so from /resume the element lookup returned null and the if(el) guard swallowed the click — nothing happened
bugs.fix: Used useNavigate + useLocation. When pathname !== '/', nav clicks now navigate('/#<id>') and land on home; added an effect that reads location.hash on arrival and smooth-scrolls to the section (or top for hero). Also converted the Resume CTA to a <Link> for SPA navigation instead of a full page reload
